news.headline: NeurAxis Completes Stock Option Exchange, Swapping 1.32 Million Options for RSUs and Granting New Management Awards
news.summary: The option-for-RSU exchange approved by shareholders on June 10 became effective July 24, cancelling 1,319,394 legacy options and issuing an equal number of RSUs, with CEO Brian Carrico receiving 199,188, CMO Adrian Miranda 199,106 and Chief Regulatory Officer Thomas Carrico 193,678 units that vested immediately. On August 13 the compensation committee added three-year-vesting grants (Carrico 193,329, CFO Timothy Henrichs 141,479, Miranda 133,341, Thomas Carrico 135,906 RSUs) plus 127,120 shares to independent directors after a consultant found pay below market.

news.headline: NRXS Stock Dips Post Q2 Earnings Despite Revenue Surge and Gross Margin Gain
news.summary: Shares fell 8.6% in the days after the August 11 print versus a 0.3% gain for the S&P 500, as the wider-than-expected loss outweighed the revenue beat. The review highlighted IB-Stim unit deliveries up 60% year over year, gross margin at 85.9%, traction with two large commercial payers and the first commercial activity in the Veterans Affairs channel.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 revenue rose 115.7% year over year to $1.928M on 60% unit growth, with gross margin expanding about 230 basis points to 85.9% as the Category I CPT code for PENFS effective January 1, 2026 pushed more devices to full reimbursement price. Cash was $8.3M at June 30 after raising $2.5M in the quarter via the ATM facility and warrant redemptions, alongside lower operating cash outflows.

news.headline: NeurAxis (NRXS) Q2 2026 Earnings Call: 100M+ Covered Lives, VA Sales Force Due by September 15
news.summary: Management confirmed more than 100 million covered lives today and targeted above 200 million by the end of 2027, with CEO Brian Carrico saying he would be highly disappointed to miss that level. The company committed to putting 10 commission-only (1099) Veterans Affairs territory representatives in the field by September 15, 2026, and flagged that hospitals generally want roughly 70% of their patient population covered before adopting broadly.

news.headline: NeurAxis Q2 EPS of -$0.19 Misses -$0.16 Consensus as Management Guides to Higher H2 Operating Expenses
news.summary: Shares sold off on the EPS miss even though revenue beat, with average selling price up 28% year over year to $992 against the $1,195 list price and prior-authorization approval rates rising to 31% year to date from 12% a year earlier. Management named its three priorities as expanding insurance coverage, improving execution in already-covered markets and building the VA channel, and warned H2 opex will rise on hires in sales, marketing, clinical and policy.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies, Adding Over 500,000 Covered Lives
news.summary: New medical policies for PENFS added more than 500,000 covered lives, expanding incremental access to IB-Stim for beneficiaries in the Mid-Atlantic region. The announcement continued the post-CPT-code drumbeat of policy wins toward the company's goal of nationwide written coverage.

catalysts.label: VA sales force fully staffed
catalysts.detail: Management committed on the August 11 call to having 10 commission-only (1099) Veterans Affairs territory representatives in the field by September 15, 2026. The VA Federal Supply Schedule contract for IB-Stim has been live since December 1, 2025, so this is the step that turns the channel into a Q4 volume driver.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report, expected around mid-November on the company's usual cadence (Q1 on May 12, Q2 on August 11). Key tests: whether triple-digit revenue growth holds, whether ASP keeps climbing from $992 toward the $1,195 list price, and how much the promised H2 opex step-up eats into the improving quarterly cash burn.

catalysts.label: Major national payer coverage decision
catalysts.detail: Talks with two large commercial payers gained traction in Q2 and management is cautiously optimistic about a coverage win in H2 2026 or early 2027. The CEO has framed a single large national payer add as the step that could slingshot the company toward profitability.

catalysts.label: State Medicaid adoption of CPT 64567
catalysts.detail: Many states have still not added CPT code 64567 to their 2026 fee schedules, leaving no payment methodology and blocking coverage for Medicaid beneficiaries even though the Category I code is in effect. Each state that loads the code onto its schedule unlocks a new reimbursed patient pool.

catalysts.label: Covered lives above 200 million
catalysts.detail: Management reiterated on the Q2 call that it expects to exceed 200 million covered lives by the end of 2027, roughly doubling from the 100 million-plus reached today. That level would effectively cover the full serviceable market and requires a steady run of payer-policy wins like the August Mid-Atlantic addition.

pulse: NeurAxis's August 11 Q2 print validated the CPT-code reimbursement thesis - revenue up 116% to $1.93M on 60% unit growth, gross margin 85.9%, ASP up 28% to $992, prior-authorization approvals at 31% versus 12% a year ago, and $8.3M cash - yet the stock fell about 9% because EPS of -$0.19 missed the -$0.16 consensus and management guided to a H2 operating expense step-up. The only company news since the print is the August 19 8-K detailing the completed option-for-RSU exchange and sizable new management and director equity grants, which locks in retention but adds dilution on top of ongoing ATM and preferred issuance. The next real tests are operational: the 10-rep VA sales force due by September 15, the two large commercial payers in negotiation, and state Medicaid programs finally loading CPT 64567 onto their fee schedules.
